description: HCL BigFix is a Unified Endpoint Management and automation platform that manages and secures endpoints and infrastructure across on-premises, hybrid, and multi-cloud environments. It provides centralized visibility and control over servers, desktops, laptops, and cloudworkloads through a single-agent architecture. The platform supports automated patch management, vulnerability remediation, compliance monitoring, software distribution, configuration management, and asset discovery across 120+ operating system variants. As frontier AI models such as Mythos accelerate vulnerability discovery and compress exploitation timelines, HCL BigFix helps organizations reduce exposure through near-real-time remediation and intelligent automation. It enables real-time queries, policy enforcement, and infrastructure operations from a unified control plane, helping organizations reduce endpoint risk, enforce compliance, and maintain control across complex IT environments.
